tools.name: leadshield_screen_submission
tools.description: Screen a contact form or inbound lead message using LeadShield's 2-stage guard (Stage 0 deterministic rules at $0.00 + Stage 1 calibrated buyer-intent classification). Returns allowed/blocked verdict, workflow branch ("deliver_to_client" or "spam_quarantine"), reason code, and buyer-intent probabili

tools.name: leadshield_get_blocked_spam_report
tools.description: Retrieve quarantined contact form spam counts, Stage 0 vs Stage 1 breakdown, category counts, and recent blocked submissions for a client or site. Example: leadshield_get_blocked_spam_report({"clientSlug":"pacific-coast-detailing","days":7})

tools.name: leadshield_get_spam_policy
tools.description: Inspect the effective server-side spam guard policy for a site, including allowed countries, phone formats, URL rules, keyword lists, and active formType preset. Example: leadshield_get_spam_policy({"site":"pacific-coast-detailing","formType":"quote_request"})

tools.name: leadshield_configure_spam_policy
tools.description: Preview (dryRun: true) or update server-side contact form spam rules for a site, including allowedCountries, allowedPhoneFormats, blockUrlsInMessage, formType preset, blockedKeywords, and requiredKeywords. Example: leadshield_configure_spam_policy({"site":"pacific-coast-detailing","allowedCountries"

tools.name: leadshield_generate_guard_embed
tools.description: Generate the 1-line zero-trust HTML script snippet, HighLevel workflow action/webhook config, WordPress plugin config, or HubSpot workflow webhook setup for any site. Example: leadshield_generate_guard_embed({"site":"pacific-coast-detailing","platform":"highlevel"})

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: leadshield_get_spam_policy · Private data: leadshield_screen_submission, leadshield_get_blocked_spam_report, leadshield_configure_spam_policy · Public sink: leadshield_screen_submission, leadshield_generate_guard_embed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: leadshield_get_spam_policy · Private data: leadshield_screen_submission, leadshield_get_blocked_spam_report, leadshield_configure_spam_policy · Public sink: leadshield_screen_submission, leadshield_generate_guard_embed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
